meaning: Verified means the listed refactor and checks were performed, not that all semantics, original names or behavior are proven.
exceptions: PreloadManager intentionally corrects stars2 assignment; its behavior tests replace equivalence proof.
Nine custom shaders preserve runtime strings and material configurations; literal AST representation changes.
Comment-only removal of generated boilerplate is not semantic acceptance.
Three matching coverage and unmatched methods are recorded separately; no exact unpublished original source claim.
ThreeJsHelper intentionally fixes Points/Line disposal and recursive/batch propagation of GL context; untouched methods remain pinned separately.
Three declaration-identity proof now handles nested same-name functions; corrected original/current alpha is documented, rather than blindly accepting a new expected hash.
